Name: Schedule Viewer
Author: BinaryLip
Description:
Adds two new menus that show the schedules for NPCs. The main menu shows the previous, current, and next schedule entries for each NPC. It will also show an "!" icon next to a character's name if they have an active quest associated with them. If you hover over a schedule entry it shows which specific tile the NPC is on in that location, which direction they are facing, and which sprite animation will be playing. On click, a second menu opens showing the full schedule for that NPC as well as their current location and if they can receive a gift today.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Config Options[/size]
[font=Courier New]ShowSchedulesKey[/font] - the key to open the Schedule Viewer (default: [font=Courier New]V[/font])
[font=Courier New]UseAddress[/font] - use Pelican Town address instead of "Home of ..." for schedule entries i.e. "2 Willow Lane" instead of "Home of Emily & Haley" (default: [font=Courier New]true[/font])
[font=Courier New]DisableHover[/font] - don't show tile, facing direction, and animation info on hover (default: [font=Courier New]false[/font])
[font=Courier New]UseLargerFontForScheduleDetails[/font] - use a larger font size on the Schedule Details page (longer location names may get cut off if enabled)
[font=Courier New]NPCSortOrder[/font] - the order the NPCs are sorted in the Schedule Viewer (default: [font=Courier New]AlphabeticalAscending[/font])
There are currently 3 filters that can be applied:
[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New]OnlyShowMetNPCs[/font] -  hides NPCs the farmer hasn't met yet (default: [font=Courier New]false[/font])
[*][font=Courier New]OnlyShowSocializableNPCs[/font] - hides NPCs you can't socialize with i.e. Gunther or Sandy before the bus is repaired (default: [font=Courier New]true[/font])
[*][font=Courier New]IgnoredNPCs[/font] - hides the listed NPCs. (default: [font=Courier New]["Dwarf", "Krobus", "Wizard"][/font])
[list]
[*]Prepending a value with "^" will match any names that start with that value (ex: "^Ha" will hide both Haley and Harvey)
[*]The name comparison is done based off of the translated NPC name. As a result of this, the default values will only work for English
[/list]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 or later on Windows/Linux/Mac
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer (mods need to match for it to be accurate).
[*]Works with mods that change NPC schedules
[*]Custom NPCs (like those from SVE and RSV) are fully supported
[*]Custom Locations are fully supported
[*]No known mod conflicts
[/list]
[size=5]Specific Mod integrations[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ - UI for editing config options
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] - able to lookup NPC information from the Schedule Viewer and details pages
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] - able to open the Schedule Viewer from the Mobile Phone
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] - see [b]Stardew Valley Expanded Add-On[/b] optional download
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11026]Toolbar Icons[/url] - able to open the Schedule Viewer from a toolbar icon
[/list]
[b]For Mod Authors[/b]: see the [url=https://github.com/BinaryLip/ScheduleViewer/blob/main/docs/author-guide.md]author guide[/url] for details on how to add your own Custom Tile Areas
